idea-plugin.name: Rust Compiler Reader
idea-plugin.description:
English

Inspect macro expansion, MIR, and generated assembly for Rust code in RustRover.

  • Macro expansion for the current item or the whole crate
  • MIR for the current function, including closures and impl methods
  • rustc-generated assembly for the current function

The plugin drives the project's own cargo and rustc, so output matches the toolchain and profile you use for normal builds. cargo-expand and cargo-show-asm are optional enhancements and are never installed automatically.

No default shortcut is assigned. Invoke Show Compiler Reader from the editor context menu or with Find Action, and bind a shortcut in Settings | Keymap if desired.

中文

在 RustRover 中查看当前 Rust 代码项的宏展开、MIR 和 rustc 生成的汇编。

  • 当前项或整个 crate 的宏展开
  • 当前函数、闭包和 impl 方法的 MIR
  • 当前函数对应的 rustc 汇编

插件直接调用项目自身的 cargo 和 rustc，因此输出与日常构建使用的 工具链和 profile 一致。cargo-expand 和 cargo-show-asm 是可选增强，插件不会自动安装。

插件默认不分配快捷键。可从编辑器右键菜单或 Find Action 调用 Show Compiler Reader，也可以在 Settings | Keymap 中自行绑定。

action.description: Show macro expansion, MIR and assembly for the current item
